task.title: Prevent SIGTERM transcript source false positives

captured_incidents.summary: Codex2 worker terminated by supervisor SIGTERM (signal 15 / exit_code 143); transcript rescanned and source snippet misclassified as auth failure.

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor worker-failure evidence admission: restrict worker failure detection strictly to authoritative structured provider terminal envelopes (and runner-gated control envelopes). Deprecate plaintext transcript regex scanning to prevent non-authoritative prompt/assistant/source lines from triggering dispatch pauses.
scope.not_changing: Provider credentials, account/quota grouping, retry thresholds, reviewer policy, runtime-state JSON, live process signals, and product code.
scope.rollout_boundary: Supervisor worker failure classification loop and provider guardrails in .orchestrator/supervisor.py.
scope.merge_revert_rollback: Revert the commit on task/SUP-WORKER-FAILURE-SIGTERM-TRANSCRIPT-GATE-20260809 or dev branch; detect_worker_failure falls back to previous plaintext parsing behavior.

contract.structured_envelope_authority: Plaintext transcript lines are treated as unprovenanced mixed-trust content and never admit failure status regardless of prefix (e.g. Error:, API Error:). Failure detection requires an authoritative structured JSON provider envelope.
contract.sigterm_exclusion: A worker_runner status failed with signal 15/9 (SIGTERM/SIGKILL) or exit_code 143/137 is excluded from worker_has_authoritative_runner_failure, preventing transcript text from being rescanned.
contract.guardrails_protection: Suppressing false failure detection on SIGTERM or exit_code=1 non-provider failures prevents provider_guardrails dispatch_pauses from being incorrectly triggered.
